title: Kerala Fish Curry (Meen Curry)
description: A tangy, fiery red fish curry from Kerala, simmered in coconut oil with kudampuli (gambooge) for its signature souring, and finished with curry leaves.

ingredients.name: Surmai
ingredients.notes: kingfish (seer fish); pomfret also works, cut into steaks

ingredients.name: Kudampuli (Gambooge)
ingredients.notes: soaked in warm water for 15 minutes

steps: Heat coconut oil in a clay pot or heavy pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds, letting them splutter.
Add the shallots, ginger, garlic and green chillies, and sauté until the shallots turn soft and translucent.
Lower the heat and add the red chilli powder and turmeric, stirring quickly for 20-30 seconds to avoid burning the spices.
Add the water, the soaked kudampuli with its soaking liquid, and salt. Bring to a boil and simmer for 8-10 minutes to let the souring agent infuse the gravy.
Gently slide in the fish pieces, making sure they're mostly submerged. Cover and simmer on low heat for 10-12 minutes without stirring vigorously, so the fish stays intact.

Scatter the curry leaves on top, give the pot a gentle swirl, and simmer for another 2 minutes. Let the curry rest for a few minutes before serving — it tastes best a little while after cooking, with steamed rice.
